sentences.en: The scene of the murder was too terrible to describe.
sentences.zh: 这起谋杀案的现场太恐怖，无法用言语描述。

sentences.en: Words fail me to describe the beauty of this landscape.
sentences.zh: 我找不到合适的词来描绘这片风景的美丽。

sentences.en: Allow us to describe our products and our business operations.
sentences.zh: 让我们来介绍一下我们的产品和业务运营情况。
